what_the_cluster_actually_is: The 1,777-row cluster at 2027-11-03 is 1,545 rows where close_time EQUALS
expiration_time at the venue — Kalshi publishes the same date in both slots for
them — plus 232 of the unresolvable tail. So the cluster is #2644's shape, not
#2660's, and this ship cannot move it. The clustering metric turns out to be a
clean SEPARATOR between the two defects rather than a measure of this one.
Recording the correction rather than quietly dropping the metric.
